title: Hochenergielaser-Waffensystem zur Nächstbereichsverteidigung der Marine
value_note: Individual value not reported in the sources reviewed; part of a session totalling approx. EUR 9.5bn across 16 Vorlagen
notes: Improves capability against agile, low-signature small targets such as drones. Demonstrator developed by Rheinmetall and MBDA Deutschland, first fired against drones from the frigate Sachsen in August 2022; operational system for the Navy expected from 2029.

title: MEKO A-200 DEU — Fregatten zur U-Boot-Jagd
value_note: Framework agreement: four frigates fixed at approx. EUR 6.3bn, plus four options at approx. EUR 5.3bn
notes: The largest item in the 8 July 2026 session.

title: Combat Fighter System of Systems Nucleus (CFSN)
value_note: Individual value not reported in the sources reviewed
notes: National research and development initiative including the development and procurement of unmanned combat air vehicles (UCAV). No prime named in the sources reviewed — an open question worth answering, since an unnamed prime on an R&D nucleus is where a small supplier has the best chance of getting in early.
